summary: The diff implements all core requirements for restoring trailer playback functionality. TrailerModal.tsx was restored with a functional component using Radix Dialog, proper z-index configuration, and all required UI states (loading, error with retry, no trailer available). MediaCard.tsx was updated with a Watch Trailer button that triggers the modal with correct media type and ID. A useGetTrailer hook was added to useQueries.ts that fetches trailer data from TMDB video endpoints with timeout handling and error management. The implementation appears complete and matches all specified requirements.
